verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents its own "Creating custom rules" capability within its transaction-categorization help collection, and marketing says busywork is "described once, done automatically." That suggests user-defined rules act automatically on incoming transactions, but the evidence is only a page title and a marketing line, with no detail on triggers, conditions or available actions. missing for 10: documented event types and triggers, rule condition and action syntax, actions beyond transaction categorization, programmatic or AI-native rule definition, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: described once, done automatically, reviewed by you before anything's final
